description: Switch this session to one of the running agents from list_agents, by `id` (or by `profile` name). Every tool afterwards talks to that agent, and the ports this session exposed on the previous agent are withdrawn. A project file this window attached stays on the shared session agent: switching to the user's own agent withdraws it, it is not attached to that agent, and switching back to the session agent attaches it again. Ask the user before switching to their own agent. A profile that is not running cannot be chosen: the answer carries the hint for starting it.

id.description: The `id` of a running agent, from list_agents.

profile.description:
The name of a profile whose agent is running, from list_agents. Use
either `id` or `profile`.

name: use_agent
